issues.title: CORS policy too permissive
issues.description: CORS policy allows any origin, any method, any header. While acceptable for development, this should be restricted for production.
issues.recommendation: Configure specific allowed origins for production deployment. Consider using environment-based configuration.

issues.title: Static ConcurrentDictionary for session state
issues.description: ThreeOptionStates uses static ConcurrentDictionary which won't survive application restarts and doesn't scale across multiple instances.
issues.recommendation: For production, consider using distributed cache (Redis) or database persistence for session state.

issues.title: SSL certificate validation disabled
issues.description: ServerCertificateCustomValidationCallback accepts all certificates. This is appropriate for development but should be disabled for production.
issues.recommendation: Use environment-based configuration to enable proper certificate validation in production.

issues.title: Static Channel for job queue
issues.description: Job queue uses static Channel which won't scale across multiple application instances.
issues.recommendation: For production scaling, consider using a message queue (RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus) for background job processing.

summary: Excellent greenfield implementation. All contracts are fully implemented with proper service layer separation. MAUI app follows MVVM pattern correctly using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm. Roman Library aesthetic is well-applied with consistent styling across all 8 pages. Minor issues relate to production-readiness configurations (CORS, SSL, session state) which are appropriate for initial development phase. Score: 96/100 (PASS). Zero CRITICAL or HIGH issues.
